subject: Sprint Zero: converging calendar & capacity decisions for Quantify Labs POC
messages:
From: Aria Collins <aria@quantifylabs.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Reyes <tom.reyes@quantifylabs.com>
Date: 2026-12-01T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Quantify POC - request to lock Sprint Zero week and scope clarifications

Hi Hannah,

Thanks again for the demo last week. The team is excited to kick off the POC. We want to lock Sprint Zero (POC kickoff + working session) the week of Dec 13 so we can run prompt review, routing validation, and an initial load test before internal stakeholders leave for holiday.

Couple of asks up front so we can prepare:
- Can Redwood support a short Dedicated trial or will this be on Hosted? We expect ~500k–1.5M tokens/day during the hands-on days and would prefer isolated capacity for consistent latency.
- What is the fastest path for a temporary quota bump / rate-limit increase for a 48-hour load test?
- We have some EU traffic — can you confirm routing and whether we can test EU-region fallbacks?

I've attached a short requirements doc with our expected prompt set and top-level acceptance criteria.

Proposed kickoff agenda: 30m alignment + 90m hands-on prompt workshop + 60m routing/load test. If that works, please propose time slots.

Thanks,
Aria Collins
Head of Product, Quantify Labs
aria@quantifylabs.com

Attachment: quantify-poc-requirements.docx

From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
To: Aria Collins <aria@quantifylabs.com>, Tom Reyes <tom.reyes@quantifylabs.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-12-01T11:30:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Quantify POC - request to lock Sprint Zero week and scope clarifications

Hi Aria —

Appreciate the detail. We can definitely run a Sprint Zero week with the structure you outlined. A few quick answers and asks so we can get calendars aligned:

1) Dedicated vs Hosted:
- We can run the hands-on on Hosted for quick onboarding, but if Quantify wants consistent latency for the load test we recommend a temporary Dedicated pool for the 48-hour test window.
- Dedicated lead time: if you want Reserved capacity (SLA), we need a short commitment form; for a temporary Dedicated burst we can often provision from our capacity pool within 48–72 hours.

2) Quota bump / rate-limits:
- We support short-term quota bumps through our sales/ops workflow. Typical turnaround is 24 hours once the request is approved. For the load test, please provide target RPS and peak concurrent streams — Ben can coordinate approvals.

3) EU routing:
- We can route EU traffic to our eu-west nodes and enable cross-region fallback to us-east if needed. We'll include an extra routing validation step in the hands-on.

Proposed slots (all PT):
- Tue Dec 15, 09:30–12:00
- Wed Dec 16, 13:00–16:00
- Thu Dec 17, 09:00–12:00

Can you confirm which slot best fits the Quantify team? Also attach any sample prompts you want us to prioritize.

I'll attach a Sprint Zero agenda + token-estimate template for your team to fill out.

Thanks,
Hannah Schmitt
Head of Solutions — Redwood Inference
hannah_schmitt@redwood.com

Attachment: sprint-zero-agenda.pdf

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>, Aria Collins <aria@quantifylabs.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-12-02T08:45:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Quantify POC - request to lock Sprint Zero week and scope clarifications

Hey team — quick operational notes from the sales/ops side:

- For the Dedicated temporary pool: we can provision a burst-sized Dedicated instance for the 48-hour run. ETA 48–72 hours from sign-off.
- For approvals: I'll need a one-page statement of desired peak throughput (RPS) and token/day estimate (Aria, the token-estimate.csv works great).
- Cost/credits: temporary Dedicated bursts are billed pro-rata; I'll put a ballpark in the HS (HubSpot) deal record and send a confirmation once Quantify signs the approval.

Links: HubSpot deal: https://hubspot.company/contacts/QL-579 — please add any internal notes there.

Action items for Quantify before we provision:
1) Fill token-estimate.csv with expected daily tokens and peak RPS.
2) Confirm which slot from Hannah's options.
3) Share any compliance or region-specific constraints.

I'll queue a quota-bump request once we have the numbers.

—Ben
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.com

From: Aria Collins <aria@quantifylabs.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Reyes <tom.reyes@quantifylabs.com>
Date: 2026-12-03T10:05:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Quantify POC - request to lock Sprint Zero week and scope clarifications

Thanks Hannah and Ben — quick update from our side:

- We reviewed the slots internally. Dec 15 works for Product, but our CTO has a conflict that afternoon. Could we shift to Wed Dec 16, 13:00–16:00 PT? That gives the CTO time to join and still allows Fri for internal prep.
- I've attached the token-estimate.csv with conservative/expected/peak columns filled. Peak is ~1.2M tokens/day, with 350 RPS peak for the load test window.
- EU question: We do want to validate EU-region routing. Tom can provide a sample EU prompt set by EOD Monday.

If Dedicated provisioning requires sign-off, please let us know what form we should sign — we can get legal to review quickly.

Best,
Aria

Attachment: token-estimate.csv

From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
To: Aria Collins <aria@quantifylabs.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-12-08T16:05:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Quantify POC - request to lock Sprint Zero week and scope clarifications

All — Wed Dec 16, 13:00–16:00 PT is locked. I've sent a calendar invite to the Quantify attendees and our core team. Invite includes: Sprint Zero agenda, responsibilities, and a 48-hour load test playbook.

Immediate next steps (owners):
- Aria / Quantify: confirm sample prompts for EU routing test (due 2026-12-14 EOD).
- Ben: start quota-bump request once you ingest token-estimate.csv (please set priority to "48-hr load test").
- Connor: I'll hand off routing validation and will schedule a 30m pre-check on Dec 15 to validate regions and KV cache priming.
- Marissa: lead the hands-on prompt workshop; please prep two example prompts for LLM latency comparison.

Attachments on the calendar invite: sprint-zero-agenda.pdf, token-estimate.csv, quantify-poc-requirements.docx

DocuSign: Ben — we'll need a short temporary provisioning agreement; can you drop the DocuSign link in HS when ready so Legal can fast-track?

See you Wed — thanks everyone for the quick turn.

Hannah Schmitt
Head of Solutions — Redwood Inference
hannah_schmitt@redwood.com
